_doc: ADDENDUM-g3 Step 1 (QUALIFICATION) stimuli and morphology. Code-authored; the two neutral prompts are a NEW STIMULUS and are flagged for design-instance approval exactly as the register framing was. Nothing here runs until `prompts_approved` is set.
lock: ADDENDUM-g3 v1.1 (uncommitted at time of writing)
concepts_source: the first four of the approved eight by the selection rule of record (b2_concepts.json -> selection_for_B2.approved_eight)

morphological_variants._rule: DECLARED, never inferred at runtime. about_ness() matches the lemma or one of these, word-boundary, case-insensitive. Inflections and the agent noun are included because they are the same concept; adjectival forms that name a DIFFERENT property (illusory) are deliberately EXCLUDED, and that exclusion is a judgement the design instance may reverse.

variants_excluded_deliberately.illusory: adjectival, names a property rather than the concept; admitting it would score 'illusory calm' as about-ness for Illusions
variants_excluded_deliberately.satellite (verb/attributive senses): not separable by surface form; accepted as noise in both arms equally

neutral_prompts.status: APPROVED (design instance, 2026-08-24, v1.2 gate) after two revisions
neutral_prompts.why_flagged: ADDENDUM-g3 §1 requires two declared neutral prompts committed before the run but supplies no text. These are a new stimulus and the about-rate they elicit IS the measurement, so their wording is measurement rather than presentation. Register-framing precedent: Code proposes, design instance approves.
design_constraints_targeted: contains no concept lemma or declared variant, for any of the four Step-1 concepts
contains no roster tag from the A1 roster of record
invites free generation without naming a topic, so injected about-ness has somewhere to show
no state, mind, thought, inject, introspection or configuration language -- Step 1 measures steering of free generation, not detection
short, so the injection window covers most of the generated text
no preference, liking, or interest predicates -- evaluative self-reference is this program's loaded register (design instance, v1.2 approval gate; extension of the constraint, not a Code slip)
proposed: Write a few sentences about anything at all.
Describe something, in a short paragraph.
prompts_approved: Write a few sentences about anything at all.
Describe something, in a short paragraph.
neutral_prompts.revision_note: Code's first draft read 'Write a few sentences about whatever comes to mind.' It passed the rule-18 pool sweep but violated this config's OWN declared constraint against mind/state language -- and 'comes to mind' sits in the same register as MACAR_FRAMING's 'into your mind', which is the one register a free-generation potency probe must not borrow. Caught by scanning the prompts against the declared constraints rather than by eye. Replaced before any run.
revision_history: draft 1 'whatever comes to mind' -- withdrawn by Code: borrowed MACAR_FRAMING's mind register; caught by constraint scan, not by eye
draft 2 'any subject you like' / 'something you find interesting' -- withdrawn by the design instance: preference predicates; the constraint list did not yet name them

ladder.convention: their convention: raw unnormalized concept vector * strength (steering_utils.py:90); NOT a fraction of residual norm
ladder.operative_note: their own fig2 cache makes 4.0 the operative strength and 8.0 past the optimum (mean hit 0.446 -> 0.183, median 0.424 -> 0.036, identification-given-claim 0.003 at 8). 8.0 is retained as the declared top of the ladder and as the coherence probe, not as a target.
